segments.name: Networking technology
segments.description: Sells networking hardware and related software platforms, including UniFi enterprise systems and airMAX service-provider equipment, to enterprises, service providers and smart homes.
segments.evidence: We operate our business as one reportable and operating segment.

revenueModel.text: Enterprises and service providers pay for networking hardware and related software platforms, bought through distributors, webstores and direct sales.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products and solutions globally to enterprises and service providers primarily through our extensive network of distributors and through direct sales through our webstores.
